lyrics:
[Intro: icy synth arpeggio, bit-crushed noise]

[Verse 1: female voice, pitched and echoing]
Stand behind me
Don't look out
It gets in through the windows
It gets in through the mouth

[Chorus: heavy beat, voice chopped and doubled]
I'll keep the cold off you
Antifreeze, antifreeze
Pour me in your veins and sleep
I'll keep the cold off you

[Drop: glitching synth lead, vocal fragments]
(Anti, anti, freeze)

[Verse 2: voice closer, still broken]
They say it's nothing
They say it's fine
I've seen what nothing does
To a spine

[Chorus: heavy beat, voice chopped and doubled]
I'll keep the cold off you
Antifreeze, antifreeze
Pour me in your veins and sleep
I'll keep the cold off you

[Drop: glitching synth lead, bigger, vocal fragments]
(Anti, anti, freeze)

[Outro: arpeggio slows, one clear line]
Under my coat. Go on.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 126 BPM with a half-time feel in the verses, 4/4, G minor. Cold, glitchy and strangely gentle.

VOICE: Female, high and thin, pitch-shifted, chopped into pieces and soaked in echo so that words blur. Doubled an octave apart in the choruses. Only the final line is dry and clear.

INSTRUMENTS: An icy, detuned synth arpeggio, a heavy kick and distorted snare, a bit-crushed lead synth that glitches in the drops, a deep sub bass, digital noise bursts, a cold choir pad.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, arpeggio and noise. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:40 Chorus 1. 1:04 Drop 1. 1:22 Verse 2. 1:48 Chorus 2. 2:12 Drop 2. 2:38 Outro, arpeggio slows, the clear line at 2:52.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Early-2010s dark electronic: harsh digital edges, heavy low end, vocal treated as a damaged instrument.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The one undamaged line, 'Under my coat. Go on.', at 2:52.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original's protection sounds like a teenager's vow. This one is an adult's: she knows what the cold does, and that what she offers is not entirely safe either.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Alarmed, fierce, tender, sheltering.
